articles.title: Meloni Pushes Oil Giants to Cap Fuel Prices as Italy Battles a New Energy Shock
articles.titleEn: Meloni Pushes Oil Giants to Cap Fuel Prices as Italy Battles a New Energy Shock
articles.summary: Q8 joins Eni and SOCAR/IP in moving to contain prices at the pump, with Eni capping petrol at €1.99 and diesel at €2.19 per litre. Behind the voluntary measures lies a bigger political fight: Rome is keeping a windfall tax on the table as six EU governments push Brussels to make energy companies share the cost of the crisis. articles.summary: The Strait of Hormuz carries a major share of the world's oil and LNG, including supplies destined for India. If shipping normalises, Indian refiners could benefit from lower freight, insurance and alternative crude costs.

articles.title: Reliance, Nayara restrict fuel sales as crude hits $107 and retail prices stay frozen: Report
articles.titleEn: Reliance, Nayara restrict fuel sales as crude hits $107 and retail prices stay frozen: Report
articles.summary: Reliance Industries and Nayara Energy have begun restricting diesel and petrol sales at some outlets as crude prices surge while domestic pump prices remain unchanged. The curbs are aimed at managing rising demand, preventing bulk hoarding and limiting losses for private fuel retailers.
